sentence: An eight-place dinner bracket where everyone in the chat votes in head-to-head matches over three rounds until one place wins.
use_when: A group can't decide where to eat and wants a fair vote
Choosing one option from eight by pairing them off
Settling a group pick with knockout rounds
dont_use_when: A single quick poll with more or fewer than eight options
Ranking or scoring options instead of picking one winner
Splitting a bill or planning a reservation
